permissions.name: chat.view
permissions.label: View Chat
permissions.allows: Read the chat of the node and follow it.

permissions.name: chat.interact
permissions.label: Interact Chat
permissions.allows: Write in the chat of the node: post, react, pin, forward into it, and change or delete what one wrote oneself.

permissions.name: chat.manage
permissions.label: Manage Chat
permissions.allows: Delete what anybody wrote in the chat of the node.

permissions.name: doc.view
permissions.label: View Documents
permissions.allows: Read the documents beside the node, or this document: its text, earlier versions, discussions and files.

permissions.name: doc.edit
permissions.label: Edit Documents
permissions.allows: Write the documents beside the node, or this document: its title, its blocks and the files it holds.

permissions.name: doc.create
permissions.label: New documents
permissions.allows: Make a document beside the node; whoever makes one owns it.

permissions.name: doc.comment
permissions.label: Comment
permissions.allows: Discuss a document: start a discussion, answer in one, react and resolve.

permissions.name: doc.manage
permissions.label: Manage Documents
permissions.allows: Manage the documents beside the node, or this document: put an earlier version back, move it, delete and restore it, and delete anybody's comment.

permissions.name: thread.view
permissions.label: View Thread
permissions.allows: See the thread and read its conversation, its state and its usage; follow it.

permissions.name: thread.interact
permissions.label: Interact Thread
permissions.allows: Drive the agent: give it input, steer or interrupt a running turn, stop or retry one, and put in order what waits.

permissions.name: thread.manage
permissions.label: Manage Thread
permissions.allows: Set the session up: its name, model and effort, the agent's parameters and instructions, its approval mode, its provider and profile; answer what the agent asks; delete the thread.

permissions.name: thread.fork
permissions.label: Fork
permissions.allows: Take a fork of the thread: a new thread of one's own, with as much of its history as one chooses.

permissions.name: thread.archive
permissions.label: Archive
permissions.allows: Archive the thread, and bring it back.

permissions.name: topic.view
permissions.label: View Topic
permissions.allows: See the topic: its name, description, status, tags and the settings that are no secret, and who has access.

permissions.name: topic.interact
permissions.label: Contribute to Topic
permissions.allows: Start threads in the topic, announce to its threads, set its status and tags, and create an environment for work there.

permissions.name: topic.manage
permissions.label: Manage Topic
permissions.allows: Rename the topic, change its description, its parameters and its default environment, delete it, and restore what was deleted in it.

permissions.name: topic.archive
permissions.label: Archive
permissions.allows: Archive the topic, and bring it back.

permissions.name: topic.start_threads
permissions.label: Start threads
permissions.allows: Start threads in the topic; whoever starts one owns it.

permissions.name: project.view
permissions.label: View Project
permissions.allows: See the project: its name, description and the settings that are no secret, and who has access.

permissions.name: project.interact
permissions.label: Contribute to Project
permissions.allows: Create topics in the project, and an environment for work there.

permissions.name: project.manage
permissions.label: Manage Project
permissions.allows: Rename the project, change its description and parameters, announce to all its open topics, move it to another org of its tree, delete it, and restore what was deleted in it.

permissions.name: project.archive
permissions.label: Archive
permissions.allows: Archive the project, and bring it back.

permissions.name: project.create_topics
permissions.label: Create topics
permissions.allows: Create topics in the project; whoever creates one owns it.

permissions.name: org.view
permissions.label: View Org
permissions.allows: See the org: its name, its members and groups, the orgs inside it and the settings that are no secret.

permissions.name: org.interact
permissions.label: Interact Org
permissions.allows: Create projects in the org, and an environment for work there.

permissions.name: org.manage
permissions.label: Manage Org
permissions.allows: Rename the org, change its parameters and tags, create orgs inside it, move it within its tree, delete it, and restore what was deleted in it.

permissions.name: org.archive
permissions.label: Archive
permissions.allows: Archive the org with everything inside it, and bring it back.

permissions.name: settings.manage
permissions.label: Manage Settings
permissions.allows: Write the policies and locks of the node, its secrets, and where what happens there is sent.

permissions.name: usage.view
permissions.label: View Usage
permissions.allows: Read every record of use in the node and below it, and the caps defined there.

permissions.name: usage.summary
permissions.label: Usage summary
permissions.allows: See how much was used in the node as figures by person, model, provider, agent and kind of environment, without anybody else's records.

permissions.name: usage.manage
permissions.label: Manage Usage
permissions.allows: Add, change and remove the usage caps of the node.

permissions.name: usage.bypass
permissions.label: Go past limits
permissions.allows: Let one turn run past a cap that is defined on the node and has no room left.

permissions.name: audit.view
permissions.label: View Audit
permissions.allows: Read the audit trail of the node and of what is inside it.

permissions.name: members.manage
permissions.label: Manage Members
permissions.allows: Invite people into the org, remove, suspend and move them, and manage its groups and service accounts.

permissions.name: directs.view
permissions.label: View Direct chats
permissions.allows: Read the direct and group chats among the org's members without being in them.

permissions.name: access.manage
permissions.label: Manage Access
permissions.allows: Change who holds what on the thing, and on a place also its defaults and its roles; decide requests for access; share it with agents.

permissions.name: access.own
permissions.label: Own
permissions.allows: Be one of its owners: hold everything on its page, and say who else owns it and who else may change the page.

permissions.name: access.external
permissions.label: Share outside
permissions.allows: Name on its page somebody who is no member of its root org.

permissions.name: thread.export
permissions.label: Export
permissions.allows: Take the conversation of the thread away as a file: its own export, its place in an archive, a copy given to an agent, and an agent's download of it.

permissions.name: chat.export
permissions.label: Export
permissions.allows: Take the chat of the node away as a file: its own export, its place in an archive, a copy given to an agent, and an agent's download of it.

permissions.name: doc.export
permissions.label: Export
permissions.allows: Take the documents beside the node, or this document, away as files: its own export, its place in an archive, a copy given to an agent, and an agent's download of it.

permissions.name: provider.view
permissions.label: View Provider
permissions.allows: See the provider in lists, with its status, plan and limits, and what each thread used of it.

permissions.name: provider.use
permissions.label: Use Provider
permissions.allows: Run turns on the provider: put a thread on it, and give input to threads that run on it, with the models and efforts the entry allows.

models.description:
The models the holder may run, by name; left out, every enabled model
of the provider.

efforts.description:
The reasoning efforts the holder may run, by name, on any model that
lists them; left out, every effort a model lists.

arrangements.description:
The arrangement types in which work done through this entry may use
the provider; left out, all that the provider's owners allow. It can
only narrow what they allow.

options_schema.description:
What an entry in the Use row of a provider lets its holder run. A member
that is left out does not narrow.
options_schema.title: ProviderUse

oneOf.description: The harness stays with its provider, and its tools run elsewhere.
The key stays with the provider and is forwarded.
A copy of the credential is shared.
The credential itself is handed over.

Arrangement.description:
A way to place a harness, its tools and a credential that an entry
may allow for work done through it. The fifth arrangement, everything
on one machine, is never chosen and so is no option.

permissions.name: provider.manage
permissions.label: Manage Provider
permissions.allows: Sign the provider in and out, rotate its key, say which models and arrangements it allows, run and update its runtime, and enable, disable and delete it.

permissions.name: provider.bypass
permissions.label: Go past limits
permissions.allows: Let one turn run past a cap on the provider that has no room left, or past the limit of its plan.

permissions.name: agent.view
permissions.label: View Agent profile
permissions.allows: See the agent profile in lists, with what its adapter declares.

permissions.name: agent.use
permissions.label: Use Agent profile
permissions.allows: Put a thread on the profile, and sign a subscription in through it.

permissions.name: agent.manage
permissions.label: Manage Agent profile
permissions.allows: Change the profile and its overrides, and enable, disable and delete it.

permissions.name: environment.view
permissions.label: View Environment
permissions.allows: See the environment: its name, owner, place and state, and what updates wait for it.

permissions.name: environment.use
permissions.label: Use Environment
permissions.allows: Start threads in the environment and have its agents act for oneself there.

permissions.name: environment.manage
permissions.label: Manage Environment
permissions.allows: Have all of the environment: say which threads run in it and where, how far agents are confined and what it offers; start, stop, recreate, update, configure, move and remove it.

permissions.name: files.view
permissions.label: View Files
permissions.allows: List, read and download the files of the environment's whole workspace, with their differences and snapshots.

permissions.name: files.manage
permissions.label: Manage Files
permissions.allows: Change the files of that workspace through Orch, and make, label and restore snapshots.

permissions.name: terminal.view
permissions.label: View Terminal
permissions.allows: See the processes of the environment and what they use, and watch an agent's own terminal there.

permissions.name: terminal.manage
permissions.label: Manage Terminal
permissions.allows: Open a shell of one's own in the environment and come back to it, signal processes there, and type into an agent's own terminal.

permissions.name: browser.view
permissions.label: View Browsers
permissions.allows: See the browsers open in the environment and the profiles it keeps, and watch a tab of one, and who else watches or drives it.

permissions.name: browser.manage
permissions.label: Manage Browsers
permissions.allows: Drive a browser of the environment with pointer and keys, open and close its tabs, open or quit one, make, rename and delete profiles, and read the address a browser is driven at.

permissions.name: vnc.view
permissions.label: View VNC
permissions.allows: See the displays served in the environment, and watch one.

permissions.name: vnc.manage
permissions.label: Manage VNC
permissions.allows: Work in a display with pointer, keys and the clipboard, open one from a preset, and close one.

permissions.name: host.view
permissions.label: View Host
permissions.allows: See the host in lists, with its capacity and what runs on it for the reader.

permissions.name: host.use
permissions.label: Use Host
permissions.allows: Have environments and a provider's runtime made on the host, or moved to it, within what the entry allows.

permissions.name: host.manage
permissions.label: Manage Host
permissions.allows: Rename and label the host, take it out of scheduling, say what it does when it is full, stop or remove what runs on it, decide the capability requests of its scope, and remove it.

permissions.name: template.view
permissions.label: View Template
permissions.allows: See the template in lists, with what it specifies.

permissions.name: template.use
permissions.label: Use Template
permissions.allows: Have an environment, or a provider's runtime, made from the template within what the entry allows.

permissions.name: template.manage
permissions.label: Manage Template
permissions.allows: Change, enable, disable and delete the template.

permissions.name: mcp.view
permissions.label: View MCP server
permissions.allows: See the server in lists, without its secrets.

permissions.name: mcp.use
permissions.label: Use MCP server
permissions.allows: Switch the server on for a scope.

permissions.name: mcp.manage
permissions.label: Manage MCP server
permissions.allows: Change, enable, disable and delete the server.

permissions.name: mount.view
permissions.label: View Mount
permissions.allows: See the mount in lists, with the machines that have it.

permissions.name: mount.use
permissions.label: Use Mount
permissions.allows: Attach the mount to an environment, or to the environments made for a scope.

permissions.name: mount.manage
permissions.label: Manage Mount
permissions.allows: Change, enable, disable and delete the mount, and say where its data may be.
